understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to navigate the grid to complete the level by activating and stepping onto all goal cells. A goal cell only completes when the carried piece matches that goal’s required shape, color, and rotation at the moment you step on it; completing all goals advances to the next level, and winning requires clearing all levels before running out of lives/turns.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each move costs 1 stamina; when stamina reaches 0 you lose 1 life and stamina resets to its maximum. If lives reach 0, the game ends (GAME_OVER). Movement is constrained by walls, and the state provides blocked_directions that must never be chosen because attempting them wastes a turn/stamina without moving. Stepping on modifier tiles changes the carried piece: shape modifiers cycle shapes 0–5 (wrapping), color modifiers cycle orange→blue→green→red→orange (wrapping), and rotation modifiers rotate 90° clockwise (0°→90°→180°→270°→0°). You must plan routes to visit needed modifiers (e.g., rotation_changer) so the piece matches the goal requirements, then step onto the goal to complete it; stamina refill tiles restore stamina.
